source.text: [Congressional Bills 119th Congress] [From the U.S. Government Publishing Office] [H. Res. 1336 Engrossed in House (EH)] <DOC> H. Res. 1336 In the House of Representatives, U. S., June 4, 2026. Resolved, That the requirement of clause 6(a) of rule XIII for a two-thirds vote to consider a report from the Committee on Rules on the same day it is presented to the House is waived with respect to any resolution reported through the legislative day of June 5, 2026, relating to a measure providing for reconciliation pursuant to title II of S. Con. Res. 33. Attest: Clerk.
